ValidationRule.description: ABN must have exactly 11 numbers with no spaces for AU Accounts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Country = 'AU', NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, 'Administrator')) ,OR((NOT(ISNUMBER(ABN_Tax_Reference__c))), LEN(ABN_Tax_Reference__c) <> 11) ,AND(CONTAINS($Profile.Name,'Qantas Loyalty -Commercial Sales'),NOT(LEFT(PRIORVALUE(OwnerId), 3) = "00G")), NOT ( $Profile.Id = '00e90000001wK8z' ) /*system Administrator*/)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: ABN must have exactly 11 numbers with no spaces
